comment: Interacts with NosGH in the formation of thiazole moieties in the nosiheptide biosynthetic pathway.

reactions.description: Dehydrogenation of thiazolines to thiazoles in nosiheptide pathway. Current data indicates that full leader peptide is required for substrate recognition.
Thiazole-formation on modified NosM precursor peptide in nosiheptide biosynthetic pathway.
